You are a programming expert. 
You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 

Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From f143647a02825038d8d6251422e1d0ebdcb6d9ea Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Sathya Perla <sathya.perla@broadcom.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Aug 2017 11:45:03 +0530
Subject: [PATCH] bnxt_en: add a dummy definition for bnxt_vf_rep_get_fid()

When bnxt VF-reps are not compiled in (CONFIG_BNXT_SRIOV is off)
bnxt_tc.c needs a dummy definition of the routine bnxt_vf_rep_get_fid().

Reported-by: kbuild test robot <fengguang.wu@intel.com>
Fixes: 2ae7408fedfe ("bnxt_en: bnxt: add TC flower filter offload support")
Signed-off-by: Sathya Perla <sathya.perla@broadcom.com>
Signed-off-by: Michael Chan <michael.chan@broadcom.com>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>

diff --git a/drivers/net/ethernet/broadcom/bnxt/bnxt_vfr.h b/drivers/net/ethernet/broadcom/bnxt/bnxt_vfr.h
index d8b5f89427fa..7787cd24606a 100644
--- a/drivers/net/ethernet/broadcom/bnxt/bnxt_vfr.h
+++ b/drivers/net/ethernet/broadcom/bnxt/bnxt_vfr.h
@@ -80,5 +80,10 @@ static inline struct net_device *bnxt_get_vf_rep(struct bnxt *bp, u16 cfa_code)
 {
 	return NULL;
 }
+
+static inline u16 bnxt_vf_rep_get_fid(struct net_device *dev)
+{
+	return 0;
+}
 #endif /* CONFIG_BNXT_SRIOV */
 #endif /* BNXT_VFR_H */
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `bnxt_vfr.h`**
   - A new inline function `bnxt_vf_rep_get_fid()` has been added. This function takes a pointer to a `net_device` structure as an argument and returns a dummy value of `0`. This addition is conditional on the `CONFIG_BNXT_SRIOV` configuration being off, which means that the function will only be compiled when the SR-IOV support is not enabled.

### Relationships
- The modification in `bnxt_vfr.h` addresses a specific issue where the function `bnxt_vf_rep_get_fid()` was required in `bnxt_tc.c` but was not defined when the Virtual Function (VF) representatives were not compiled in. By adding this dummy definition, the code in `bnxt_tc.c` can compile successfully without errors related to the missing function, thus fixing the reported issue. This change is linked to the previous commit that added TC flower filter offload support, indicating that the absence of this function was causing build failures in that context.
